      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;

          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          example: true

        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. When true and an existing owner has the same lastName
            and address (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace), the new owner joins
            that household and all members receive the same stable householdId. Duplicate
            detection no longer depends on this flag: it is driven solely by the derived
            identityKey, so two members of the same household with different telephones are
            always allowed and only an exact full identityKey match is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the telephone,
                email and household checks into a single value: the normalized telephone,
                the email (or empty) and the householdId (or empty), joined by '|'. A create
                request is rejected with 409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned once at creation. Starts
                at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure. Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the REGION component of the customerCode
                (the part before the first '-'), which is derived from the postcode.
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it was not a hard duplicate
                (its identityKey was unique) but it shared an existing owner's lastName
                (case-insensitive) and postcode while carrying a different telephone;
                otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of,
                i.e. the same lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Null when
                possibleDuplicate is false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the supplied birthDate measured against
                the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

      properties:

          title: Title

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:

          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        - id

          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. The householdId is always computed deterministically from
            (lastName, postcode), so this flag no longer creates the household link. It only
            bypasses the household duplicate block: because owners sharing a lastName and postcode
            are the same household, a second such owner is rejected with 409 unless this flag is
            true, in which case it is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

        - type: object
          properties:

            initials:

              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number

            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit

              maximum: 9

            householdId:

              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).

                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the telephone,
                email and household checks into a single value: the normalized telephone,
                the email (or empty) and the householdId (or empty), joined by '|'. A create
                request is rejected with 409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned once at creation. Starts
                at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure. Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the REGION component of the customerCode

                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

              type: array

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits and,
            when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            must fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's ageBand is derived from it, measured against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. The householdId is always computed deterministically from
            (lastName, postcode), so this flag no longer creates the household link. It only
            bypasses the household duplicate block: because owners sharing a lastName and postcode
            are the same household, a second such owner is rejected with 409 unless this flag is
            true, in which case it is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode. Derived from the owner's own customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household, keyed on
                (lastName, postcode). Computed deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized lastName, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every
                owner with the same lastName (case-insensitive, with collapsed whitespace) and
                postcode receives the same value automatically, regardless of creation order.
              type: string
              example: '3f2a1c9d8b7e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the telephone,
                email and household checks into a single value: the normalized telephone,
                the email (or empty) and the householdId (or empty), joined by '|'. A create
                request is rejected with 409 only when the new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned once at creation. Starts
                at 1; adds 1 when an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner has
                no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure. Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region: the REGION component of the customerCode
                (the part before the first '-'), which is derived from the postcode.
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be derived.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day (the adjusted registration
                date); otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it was not a hard duplicate
                (its identityKey was unique) but it shared an existing owner's lastName
                (case-insensitive) and postcode while carrying a different telephone;
                otherwise false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of,
                i.e. the same lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Null when
                possibleDuplicate is false. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored email:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the supplied birthDate measured against
                the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## What changed

The `householdId` is now **deterministic** — the first 12 hex characters of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode)` — so owners sharing a lastName and postcode share it automatically, and the household is keyed on `(lastName, postcode)`.

1. **`AssignHousehold.java`** — rewritten. It no longer reads `sharesHousehold`, scans for existing members, or back-links other owners. It just computes and sets the deterministic id from the owner's own normalized lastName + postcode. Every owner now always carries a householdId.

2. **`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java`** — now a **household duplicate check**. It rejects with 409 (`OwnerIdentityConflictException`) when an existing owner shares the new owner's `householdId` (i.e. same lastName + postcode). `sharesHousehold: true` bypasses the block — the owner is created as a declared household member. 3. **`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** — a declared member (`sharesHousehold: true`) is now left `possibleDuplicate = false` and short-circuits before the soft-match scan: "a declared member is not a suspected duplicate."

4. **`AssignHouseholdSize.java`** — logic unchanged (it already counts by `getHouseholdId()`); now that the id is always populated, the household-size input to the membership pipeline keys off the computed household. Javadoc updated.

That follows directly from the spec's rule that a non-declared same-household owner is rejected outright.
